findings.title: Slightly indirect column-matching loop for a fixed 4-field case
findings.detail: match() builds a slice of anonymous {name string; into *int} structs and loops over it to fill four fixed fields (question/decision/rationale/source) via pointer indirection. With exactly four fixed, known column names and one call site, four plain map lookups (`q, ok := at["question"]`, etc.) would read at least as clearly without the pointer-into-struct indirection. Not a functional problem, just generic-looking machinery for a single concrete shape.
